units.source_text: 名人晚年，十多年里只比赛了三盘。

en.t: In his later years, the Master played only three matches over more than ten years.

units.source_text: 三次交锋，名人都中途患病。

en.t: In all three contests, the Master fell ill partway through.
After the first game, he immediately became ill.

units.source_text: 第三盘之后便与世长辞。

en.t: After the third game, he passed away.

units.source_text: 三盘虽都下完，可是由于中途养病，

en.t: Although all three games were completed, because he had to recuperate midway,

units.source_text: 第一盘花了两个月，第二盘花了四个月，

en.t: the first game took two months, and the second took four months,

units.source_text: 第三盘告别赛更长，竟达七个月之久。

en.t: while the third, his farewell match, was even longer, lasting as much as seven months.
